title: Assam: Bongaigaon Schools Revise Timings Amid Intense Heatwave - Pratidin Time
full_text:
School timings in Bongaigaon district have been revised in view of the prevailing intense heatwave.
The decision has been taken to reduce students’ exposure to the scorching heat and ensure safer learning conditions amid the ongoing hot weather.
New School Timings
As per the directive issued by the District Inspector of Schools, Bongaigaon, the revised timings will apply to schools across the district.
Lower Primary (LP) schools: 7.30 am to 11.30 am, Upper Primary schools: Classes will continue until 12 noon, Higher Secondary schools: Classes will continue until 12.30 pm
The change in schedule has been introduced, keeping in mind the intense heat conditions being experienced across the district.
School authorities have been directed to follow the revised timings and ensure that students are not unnecessarily exposed to the afternoon heat.
